last_sync.summary: Adds Capoworks ECU build-resource evidence tooling: deterministic ELF resource extraction, bounded calibration plans, a manual resource-matrix workflow, and a resource gate that must pass before custom firmware is packaged. Also adds new custom-firmware build inputs for VE RPM count, airmass blend size, cylinder trim count, and engine presets, and makes macOS unit-test and configuration generation use Homebrew GNU Make and modern Bash.

decisions.rationale: Adds Capoworks ECU build-resource tooling and a new build-resource guide. Custom firmware builds now accept VE RPM count (16/32), airmass blend size (8/16), cylinder trim count (1-12), and engine presets, and are resolved through the canonical catalog instead of the workflow's own board table. A resource gate now runs after the build and before packaging, so a rejected resource report prevents firmware publication. Normal firmware CI and Core8 CI also collect resource evidence. Builders should read the new resource guide and expect a failed resource gate to block artifacts; results prove build-time technical fit only, not runtime or hardware behavior.
evidence: docs/build-resources.md added with evidence identity, statuses, calibration coverage, and command reference
misc/firmware_builder/resources.py, matrix.py, catalog.py, calibration.py, pipeline.py added
custom-firmware-build.yaml adds ve_rpm_count, airmass_blend_size, cylinder_trim_count, engine_presets inputs and Extract and gate resources step before Package validated firmware
build-firmware.yaml and capoworks-checks.yaml add calibration.py collect steps; Core8 firmware upload now requires collect_resources success
docs/build-modules.md links to build-resources.md; firmware/CHANGELOG.md adds Tooling entry

decisions.rationale: CI-only change: the macOS unit-test job installs Homebrew GNU Make and prepends its bin directory to PATH. No firmware behavior, build option, flashing step, or tune layout changes for users.
evidence: .github/workflows/build-unit-tests.yaml: brew install mtools zip dosfstools make and echo "$(brew --prefix make)/libexec/gnubin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

decisions.rationale: Replaces mapfile with a read loop in the engine preset renderer so it runs under Bash 3.2. The generated preset profile output is unchanged; this is a build-script portability fix with no user-facing firmware or configuration change.
evidence: firmware/controllers/modules/engine_preset_profile.sh: mapfile -t supported and mapfile -t enum_symbols replaced with while IFS= read -r loops

decisions.rationale: Build-tooling portability change: the macOS unit-test job installs Homebrew Bash and prints make/bash versions, and gen_config_board.sh uses an env-based Bash shebang. No firmware feature, build option, or tune behavior changes for users.
evidence: .github/workflows/build-unit-tests.yaml: brew install ... bash, PATH update, make --version and bash --version
firmware/gen_config_board.sh: shebang changed from #!/bin/bash to #!/usr/bin/env bash

decisions.rationale: Integration merge of the build-resource-matrix branch. Its child commits are audited separately and the merge adds no conflict-resolution changes with distinct user-facing effect.
